basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of prestigious Pacific Hts, this charming top floor 1 bdrm condo, has been newly painted, and hardwood floors had been newly refinished. This spacious unit features generous size living and dining rooms plus an extra office alcove perfectly suited for a home office, providing an ideal workspace. Assigned roof rights offers potential to explore the creation of a roof deck with even more remarkable vistas. The building offers shared laundry facilities, pkg for 1 car, & a common yard. Within walking distance, you'll find an array of shopping and dining options on both Sacramento st & Laurel Village. Close to #1 bus on California street. This is truly a great opportunity
